message.content: I'm ending my turn without trading. I have $514 and own St. Charles Place and States Avenue, two of the three pinks. The third pink, Virginia Avenue, is still in the bank, so I can try to buy it instead of trading for it. My new Pennsylvania Avenue gives me a stake in the greens, but Grok won't give up North Carolina cheaply, so there's no good deal to make yet.
message.reasoning: Not much to trade right now - I hold St Charles, States, B&O, and Pennsylvania Ave, with Virginia still unowned. I could try proposing a North Carolina trade with p4, but they'd want Pennsylvania in return, which seems unlikely to work, so I'll just end my turn.

function.name: end_turn
function.arguments: {"public_message": "Greens are a two-way race now, Grok. Your roll."}
